# Cyclic subgroup generated by an element of a group

Let $G$ be a group and let $g \in G$. The *cyclic subgroup generated by $g$* is the subgroup $\langle g \rangle = \{g^n : n \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ of $G$, made up of all integer powers of $g$.

## Sources

- David S. Dummit and Richard M. Foote, Abstract Algebra, 3rd ed., John Wiley & Sons, 2004.
